Detailed Description

Formal "void" data-type object.

A placeholder for "no data-type". This should be the only object with meta-type set to TYPE_VOID

◆ decode()

void ghidra::TypeVoid::decode ( Decoder & decoder,
TypeFactory & typegrp )
protected

Restore void data-type, with an id.

Parse a <type> element for the id attributes of the void data-type. The void data-type is usually marshaled with the <void> element, but this is an alternate encoding that allows a specific id to be associated with the data-type when core data-types are specified.

Parameters
decoderis the stream decoder
typegrpis the factory owning this data-type

References ghidra::Decoder::getNextAttributeId(), and ghidra::Decoder::readUnsignedInteger().

◆ encode()

void ghidra::TypeVoid::encode ( Encoder & encoder) const
virtual

Encode the data-type to a stream.

Encode a formal description of the data-type as a <type> element. For composite data-types, the description goes down one level, describing the component types only by reference.

Parameters
encoderis the stream encoder
